audit.verdictEn: The story count matches the snapshot, but the bible still says sixty-four; most volatile counts lack supporting evidence.

risks.itemZh: 篇数标题与正文不一致
risks.itemEn: Story-count heading conflicts with the contents
risks.detailZh: 余响集标题称六十四篇，正文含第六十五篇；快照与检索证据均称六十五篇。
risks.detailEn: The anthology heading says sixty-four, while the text includes No. 65 and the snapshot and evidence say sixty-five.

risks.itemZh: 易变实现计数无法由证据核验
risks.detailZh: KI、已实现数、ARCH 章节及对话树、格数、旗标、NPC 数均只有快照陈述，所给检索证据未佐证。
risks.detailEn: The supplied evidence does not substantiate KI, implementation, ARCH, dialogue, flag, or NPC counts.

risks.itemZh: 六十五篇清单缺少逐篇证据
risks.itemEn: The sixty-five-story list lacks item-by-item evidence
risks.detailZh: 检索证据只覆盖少数篇目，无法核对完整名单、篇数及每篇的对应关系。
risks.detailEn: Top-10 evidence covers only a few stories, so the full list and item-to-count mapping cannot be checked.

transitions.fromZh: 钟摆停在最低处，尚未交接
transitions.fromEn: The pendulum rests at its lowest point, with no handover
transitions.toZh: 钟摆继续停驻，不指定接任者
transitions.toEn: The pendulum remains at rest; no successor is assigned
transitions.narrativeZh: 未竟厅不再安排接手者；摆停在最低处，仍由它自己停着。
transitions.narrativeEn: The Hall assigns no successor; the pendulum remains at rest on its own.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 守摆人不召集交接，也不催摆动。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The keeper calls no handover and does not urge the pendulum to swing.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 摆旁空位，不必有人坐下。
transitions.atlasHookEn: The empty place beside the pendulum needs no one seated.

transitions.fromZh: 薄簿合着，干痕尚未入册
transitions.fromEn: The thin ledger is closed; the dry mark is unentered
transitions.toEn: The dry mark remains where it is, unrecorded
transitions.narrativeZh: 潮水退去又回来，干痕仍在；薄簿不为它添页。
transitions.narrativeEn: The tide recedes and returns; the mark remains, and the ledger gains no entry.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 阿汐不翻薄簿，也不替干痕作证。
transitions.npcReactionEn: Axi leaves the ledger closed and does not make the mark testimony.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 一道没有进薄簿的干痕。
transitions.atlasHookEn: A dry mark left out of the ledger.

transitions.fromEn: Ash rests on a fingertip, not yet fallen
transitions.toZh: 灰仍由它自己决定是否落下
transitions.toEn: The ash is left to fall, or not, in its own time
transitions.narrativeZh: 阿汐不擦灰，也不催它；它落不落，都不必成为一笔记录。
transitions.narrativeEn: Axi neither wipes nor hurries the ash; whether it falls need not become an entry.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 她继续添柴，不再查看指尖。
transitions.npcReactionEn: She keeps feeding the stove and no longer checks her fingertip.
transitions.atlasHookEn: The ash is unhurried; the day goes on.

transitions.fromZh: 风钟海岸已开放，余响仍待行走
transitions.fromEn: Windbell Coast is open; its coda still awaits a walk
transitions.toZh: 旅人沿岸行走，不把见证改作胜利
transitions.toEn: The traveler walks the coast, keeping witness distinct from victory
transitions.narrativeZh: 海岸仍无 Boss 与新登记 NPC；行走只让余响有所归处。
transitions.narrativeEn: The coast gains no boss or registered NPC; walking gives the afterglow a place.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 海风带着钟的余温，仍不让人听清。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The wind carries the bells' warmth without letting them be heard clearly.
transitions.atlasHookEn: Walk the afterglow along Windbell Coast.

atlasDraft.pZh: 潮水退去，阿汐添了一根柴。指尖的灰还没有落，她没有催它。门槛边的盐仍在，薄簿仍合着。她没有去看海，只让灶火照自己的火候燃着。
atlasDraft.pEn: At ebb, Axi fed one stick into the stove. The ash on her fingertip had not fallen; she did not hurry it. The salt remained by the threshold, and the thin ledger stayed shut. She did not look at the sea. She let the fire keep its own heat.
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some warmth remains after the fire goes out.
